map.EER 和 COP 是一回事吗？: Are EER and COP the same thing?
map.数值算法相同（输出/输入），但 EER 指制冷、COP 指制热；季节版分别为 S: The numerical algorithm is the same (output/input), but EER refers to cooling and COP to heating; the seasonal versions are SEER and SCOP respectively.
map.一级能效一定省最多吗？: Does grade 1 efficiency always save the most energy?
map.高效机初投高，使用小时数高时差额电费更快回收；低频使用则回收期长，需按使用时长权: Efficient units cost more upfront, but with high annual operating hours the electricity savings pay back the difference faster; with low usage the payback is long, so weigh it by hours of use.
